content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I frequently need to display specific information on the [product_name]'s LCD screen. However, the parameter blocks take up significant space, even when I only want to show a few characters, such as three. Is it possible to decrease this unused width shown in red? [IMAGE]
Unfortunately, it's not possible. The output field widths are fixed and cannot be adjusted.

analysis.insight_summary: Users find it frustrating that parameter blocks on the [product_name]'s LCD occupy unnecessary width, making it hard to efficiently use the display space, especially for short text entries. This limitation affects user flexibility and overall usability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like to have the option to adjust the width of parameter display blocks on the [product_name]'s LCD to better fit short text and conserve screen space.
